_comment: Best-effort against https://hermes-agent.nousresearch.com/docs/user-guide/features/cron -- not verified against a real installed Hermes yet. Per the profile-distributions guide, cron/ files are distribution-owned but NOT auto-enabled on install; run `hermes -p alfred cron list` after installing to see this, and activate it explicitly if the schema below turns out right.
name: alfred-connector-health-check
prompt: Call the connector_status MCP tool. If any connector's state is not "ok", report which one(s) and their last_error -- otherwise say nothing (this is a health check, not a status report every 6 hours).
